_sources: ESCAP-RDTII-2.1_ Round 2 Database.xlsx#'RDTII 2.1 Methodology' (criteria, score levels)
_id_spelling_note: Indicator IDs are TEXT, spelled as the Indicator Reference sheet spells them: 4.1 (not 4.10, which is how the Methodology sheet's float renders under its 0.00 number format), 4.01, 12.01 and 12.4.1 to 12.4.7.
_definition_note: definition_derived: false means the definition and the name are the hand-written Round 1 text, kept byte for byte. true means both were composed mechanically from the two sheets, never by a model.

1.4.name: Trade defence measures including anti-dumping, countervailing duties and safeguards on ICT-related goods imported by other economies within the considered United Nations region
1.4.definition: Trade defence measures including anti-dumping, countervailing duties and safeguards on ICT-related goods imported by other economies within the considered United Nations region. Scoring criteria: 1) More than three measures 2) Three measures 3) Two measures 4) One measure 5) No measure (0.25 for each measure, up to 1)
1.4.criteria:
1) More than three measures
2) Three measures
3) Two measures
4) One measure
5) No measure
(0.25 for each measure, up to 1)

2.1.name: Foreign exclusions from public procurement related to ICT goods and digital services
2.1.definition: Foreign exclusions from public procurement related to ICT goods and digital services. Scoring criteria: 1) For any legislative measure excludes foreign firms from public procurement under any circumstances, or more than one measure under category (2) 2) For any legislative measure excludes a specific (group) of foreign firm(s) from public procurement 3) No measure (when there is only a legal basis that grants the government the power to exclude foreign firms)
2.1.criteria:
1) For any legislative measure excludes foreign firms from public procurement under any circumstances, or more than one measure under category (2)
2) For any legislative measure excludes a specific (group) of foreign firm(s) from public procurement
3) No measure (when there is only a legal basis that grants the government the power to exclude foreign firms)

2.2.name: Specific requirements on source codes, encryption and trade secrets
2.2.definition: Specific requirements on source codes, encryption and trade secrets. Scoring criteria: 1) For any requirement to surrender patents, source codes or trade secrets as a condition for participating in tenders 2) For any requirement to use specific encryption to win tenders 3) No measure
2.2.criteria:
1) For any requirement to surrender patents, source codes or trade secrets as a condition for participating in tenders
2) For any requirement to use specific encryption to win tenders
3) No measure

2.3.name: Limitations in procurement bidding
2.3.definition: Limitations in procurement bidding. Scoring criteria: 1) For any measure that directly discriminate against foreign bidders OR more than one measure under category (2) 2) For any measures measure that applies to all bidders, such as local content requirements and performance-based conditions 3) No measure (when there is only a legal basis that grants the government the power to impose limitations in procurement bidding)
2.3.criteria:
1) For any measure that directly discriminate against foreign bidders OR more than one measure under category (2)
2) For any measures measure that applies to all bidders, such as local content requirements and performance-based conditions
3) No measure (when there is only a legal basis that grants the government the power to impose limitations in procurement bidding)

3.1.name: Foreign equity limits in sectors relevant to digital trade
3.1.definition: Foreign equity limits in sectors relevant to digital trade. Scoring criteria: 1) Ban (0%) in at least one sector OR if only a minority stake in more than one sector 2) A minority stake (1-50%) allowed in one sector 3) A controlling stake (51-99%) allowed OR restrictions only exist in SOEs 4) Full ownership (100%) allowed in relevant for digital trade Exception: Not cover foreign equity cap in telecom sector (covered under Pillar 5) and e-commerce sector (covered under Pillar 12)
3.1.criteria:
1) Ban (0%) in at least one sector OR if only a minority stake in more than one sector
2) A minority stake (1-50%) allowed in one sector
3) A controlling stake (51-99%) allowed OR restrictions only exist in SOEs
4) Full ownership (100%) allowed in relevant for digital trade
3.1.exception: Exception: Not cover foreign equity cap in telecom sector (covered under Pillar 5) and e-commerce sector (covered under Pillar 12)

3.2.name: Joint venture requirements
3.2.definition: Joint venture requirements. Scoring criteria: 1) For any measure 2) No measure

3.3.name: Nationality or residency requirements for board of directors or managers
3.3.definition: Nationality or residency requirements for board of directors or managers. Scoring criteria: 1) For any measure 2) No measure

3.4.name: Screening of investment and acquisitions
3.4.definition: Screening of investment and acquisitions. Scoring criteria: 1) A case that the screening mechanism has been used to block an investment in a sector relevant for digital trade 2) Two or more investment screening mechanisms 3) A screening mechanism 4) No screening mechanism Exception: Anti-trust measures related to M&A are not considered a restriction, unless discriminatory.
3.4.criteria:
1) A case that the screening mechanism has been used to block an investment in a sector relevant for digital trade
2) Two or more investment screening mechanisms 
3) A screening mechanism
4) No screening mechanism
3.4.exception: Exception: Anti-trust measures related to M&A are not considered a restriction, unless discriminatory.

3.5.name: Commercial presence requirements to offer cross-border services in sectors relevant to digital trade
3.5.definition: Commercial presence requirements to offer cross-border services in sectors relevant to digital trade. Scoring criteria: 1) For any measure 2) No measure

4.01.name: Patent application issues
4.01.definition: Patent application issues. Scoring criteria: 1) Differential treatment between local and foreign firms, requirements to appoint local representative, and a rejection of patent application in a discriminatory manner. 2) Non-transparent process, high filing fees, high registration costs, substantive examination, and the requirement to file a patent locally before filing abroad. 3) No restriction
4.01.criteria:
1) Differential treatment between local and foreign firms, requirements to appoint local representative, and a rejection of patent application in a discriminatory manner. 
2) Non-transparent process, high filing fees, high registration costs, substantive examination, and the requirement to file a patent locally before filing abroad. 
3) No restriction

4.2.definition: Patent enforcement issues: civil and administrative procedures and remedies; and provisional measures. Scoring criteria: 1) Abesence of civil and administrative procedures and remedies, and provisional measures 2) Adopt civil and administrative procedures and remedies, or provisional measures 3) Adopt civil and administrative procedures and remedies, and provisional measures
4.2.criteria:
1) Abesence of civil and administrative procedures and remedies, and provisional measures
2) Adopt civil and administrative procedures and remedies, or provisional measures
3) Adopt civil and administrative procedures and remedies, and provisional measures

4.3.name: Patent enforcement issues: others
4.3.definition: Patent enforcement issues: others. Scoring criteria: 1) For any restriction with high impact, when the issue affecting all circumstances and sectors, OR more than one measure of category (2) 2) For any restriction with limited impact, when the issue affecting to a specific circumstance or sector 3) No restriction
4.3.criteria:
1) For any restriction with high impact, when the issue affecting all circumstances and sectors, OR more than one measure of category (2)
2) For any restriction with limited impact, when the issue affecting to a specific circumstance or sector
3) No restriction

4.5.name: Lack of copyright framework and exceptions
4.5.definition: Lack of copyright framework and exceptions. Scoring criteria: 1) Lack of copyright legal framework OR lack of copyright exceptions 2) Unclear copyright exceptions, such as three-step test and other types of copyright exceptions 3) Clear copyright exceptions following fair use or fair dealing model
4.5.criteria:
1) Lack of copyright legal framework OR lack of copyright exceptions
2) Unclear copyright exceptions, such as three-step test and other types of copyright exceptions
3) Clear copyright exceptions following fair use or fair dealing model

4.6.definition: Online copyright enforcement issues: civil and administrative procedures and remedies; and provisional measures. 4.6.criteria:

3) Adopt civil and administrative procedures and remedies, and provisional measures

4.9.name: Mandatory disclosure of trade secrets, such as souce code and algorithms
4.9.definition: Mandatory disclosure of trade secrets, such as souce code and algorithms. Scoring criteria: 1) For any disclosure requirement affecting an entire sector or all sectors horizontally OR More than one measure of category (2) 2) For any disclosure requirement of limited impact affecting only specific types of products or specific circumstance (i.e., disclosure due to court order, regulatory proceedings, or national threat provision for certain companies) 3) No measure OR when the Government mandates to disclose trade secrets when necessary to protect the public interest and safeguards against unfair commercial use
4.9.criteria:
1) For any disclosure requirement affecting an entire sector or all sectors horizontally OR More than one measure of category (2)
2) For any disclosure requirement of limited impact affecting only specific types of products or specific circumstance (i.e., disclosure due to court order, regulatory proceedings, or national threat provision for certain companies)
3) No measure OR when the Government mandates to disclose trade secrets when necessary to protect the public interest and safeguards against unfair commercial use

4.1.definition: Lack of effective trade secrets legal framework. Scoring criteria: 1) Lack of trade secrets legal framework that is able to provide effective protection 2) Limited practice/scope addressing protection of trade secrets OR practices with certain clauses included in the IP law/ relevant law 3) Presence of effective protection of trade secrets protection in any forms
4.1.criteria:

5.1.name: Lack of passive infrastructure sharing
5.1.definition: Lack of passive infrastructure sharing. Scoring criteria: 1) No passive infrastructure sharing obligation 2) Passive sharing is not mandated, but it is practiced in the market 3) Passive sharing is mandated

2) Passive sharing is not mandated, but it is practiced in the market

5.2.name: Foreign equity limits in telecom sector
5.2.definition: Foreign equity limits in telecom sector. Scoring criteria: 1) Ban (0%) OR if only a minority stake in more than one measures 2) A minority stake (1-50%) allowed 3) A controlling stake (51-99%) allowed OR restrictions only exist in SOEs 4) Full ownership (100%) allowed in telecommunication sector

2) A minority stake (1-50%) allowed

5.3.name: Shares owned by the Government in telecom companies
5.3.definition: Shares owned by the Government in telecom companies. Scoring criteria: 1) At least one companies with government shares above 50% OR more than one measure of category (2) 2) One company with government shares between 1% and 50% 3) No shares owned by the government in telecom companies
5.3.criteria:

2) One company with government shares between 1% and 50%

5.4.name: Lack of functional/accounting separation
5.4.definition: Lack of functional/accounting separation. Scoring criteria: 1) No funcation/accounting separation is mandated 2) Only accounting separation is mandated 3) Only functional seperation is mandated 4) Both accounting and functional separations are mandated

5.5.name: Licensing requirements in telecom sector for operators
5.5.definition: Licensing requirements in telecom sector for operators. Scoring criteria: 1) For any strict licensing scheme (e.g., discrimination for foreign providers, minimum capital requirements, and mandatory performances requirements) 2) No strict licensing scheme
5.5.criteria:
1) For any strict licensing scheme (e.g., discrimination for foreign providers, minimum capital requirements, and mandatory performances requirements)
2) No strict licensing scheme

5.7.name: Lack of independent telecom authority
5.7.definition: Lack of independent telecom authority. Scoring criteria: 1) No independent telecom authority 2) Independent telecom authority is established
5.7.criteria:
1) No independent telecom authority
2) Independent telecom authority is established

6.1.name: Ban and local processing requirements
6.1.definition: Is there a ban on cross-border transfer of data AND/OR a requirement to process certain data domestically? A complete prohibition on transferring data abroad is a ban; a requirement to process data locally is also captured here. Boundary with 6.4: if the law COMPLETELY prohibits transfer abroad it is 6.1; if transfer is allowed once conditions are satisfied (consent, adequacy) it is 6.4. Measures applied only to the Government's own data are NOT scored (commercial activity only).
6.1.criteria:
1) Ban and/or local processing requirement for all sectors or personal data, OR more than one measure in category (2)
2) Ban and/or local processing  requirement applied to specific sector, specific data, non-personal data, or transfer is prohibited to one country
3) No requirement
6.1.exception: Exception: Not score data localization measure applied to government data.

6.2.name: Local storage requirements
6.2.definition: Must a copy of certain data be kept within the economy (the data may still cross borders)? Distinct from 6.3: storage does not require building or owning a data centre. A law imposing both local storage and local processing is recorded under both 6.1 and 6.2. Measures applied only to the Government's own data are NOT scored.
6.2.criteria:
1) Local storage requirement for all sectors or personal data, OR more than one measure in category (2)
2) Local storage requirement applied to specific sector, specific data or non-personal data
3) No requirement
6.2.exception: Exception: Not score data localization measure applied to government data.

6.3.name: Infrastructure requirements
6.3.definition: Must a provider establish or use a local data centre or local server as a precondition to provide data-using services? Does NOT cover operational or technical requirements on an already-established data centre. A data-centre requirement not tied to data transfer is not scored. Measures applied only to the Government's own data are NOT scored.
6.3.exception: Exception: Not score data localization measure applied to government data.

6.4.name: Conditional flow regimes
6.4.definition: Does the economy impose OTHER conditions (beyond storage/processing) that must be met before data can be transferred abroad, such as the data subject's consent, an adequacy evaluation by the business, or a government adequacy determination? Boundary with 6.1: if transfer is allowed once the conditions are satisfied it is 6.4; a complete prohibition is 6.1. Measures applied only to the Government's own data are NOT scored.
6.4.criteria:
1) Conditions for all sectors or personal data 
2) Conditions for specific data or non-personal data
3) No condition
6.4.exception: Exception: Not score data localization measure applied to government data.

6.5.name: Not in an agreement with binding commitments on data transfer
6.5.definition: Not in an agreement with binding commitments on data transfer. From the RDTII 2.1 framework document; not present in the Round 1 database extract.
6.5.exception: From the RDTII 2.1 framework document; not present in the Round 1 database extract.

7.1.name: Lack of comprehensive legal framework for data protection
7.1.definition: Has the economy adopted a COMPREHENSIVE (broad, cross-sectoral) data-protection framework with detailed data-subject rights (access, rectification, erasure, portability) covering collection, processing, and cross-border transfer? A law limited to one sector is a sectoral law, not a comprehensive framework.
7.1.criteria:
1) No data protection legal framework
2) Data protection legal framework only to specific sectors (sectoral law)
3) Comprehensive data protection framework

7.2.name: Lack of dedicated legal framework for cybersecurity
7.2.definition: Has the economy adopted a DEDICATED cybersecurity legal framework (horizontal, or cybersecurity-specific for a sector)? Non-dedicated means no cybersecurity-specific law, relying on general laws instead.
7.2.criteria:
1) No cybersecurity legal framework
2) Non-dedicated cybersecurity legal framework and/or dedicated cybersecurity law only to specific sectors (sectoral law)
3) Dedicated cybersecurity legal framework (horizontal)

7.3.name: Minimum period of data retention requirements
7.3.definition: Does the economy impose a MINIMUM data-retention period (firms must retain data for at least a set duration)? Distinct from Pillar 6 storage: retention concerns duration, storage concerns location. Only minimum-period requirements are scored; maximum-retention limits are NOT scored in RDTII 2.1.
7.3.criteria:
1) Minimum period of data retention requirement
2) No data retention requirement
7.3.exception: Exception: Not score requirement applied to government data.

7.4.name: Data Protection Impact Assessment or Data Protection Officer requirements
7.4.definition: Must firms appoint a Data Protection Officer (DPO) or perform a Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA)? Scoring is driven by the DPO requirement.
7.4.criteria:
1) DPO and DPIA OR only DPO requirement, applied to all sectors
2) DPO and DPIA OR only DPO requirement, applied to a specific sector
3) No requirement

7.5.name: Requirements to allow Government access to personal data
7.5.definition: Can the Government access personal data WITHOUT the explicit authorization of an independent judicial body (a court decision, a judicial warrant, or an equivalent order)? Provisions granting officials access, production, search, or seizure powers over data on their own authority fall here; powers exercisable only under a court order or judicial warrant do not.
7.5.criteria:
1) For any measure that allows government to access data without court orders
2) No measure

8.4.definition: Monitoring requirements. Scoring criteria: 1) Any monitoring requirement (monitor the users’ activities or remove or block content) 2) Any requirement to active monitoring of users’ activities without any legal obligation to remove or block the content 3) No measure

9.1.definition: Blocking or filtering commercial web content. Scoring criteria: 1) Any blocking measure 2) Any filtering measure 3) No cases of blocking nor filtering (except internationally agreed illegal content/child pornography) Exception: Not score political content, criminal content (e.g., child pornography), aged-restricted content, defamation and other non-commercial content.

3) No cases of blocking nor filtering (except internationally agreed illegal content/child pornography)

10.1.definition: Import ban applied to ICT goods and online services (e.g. network equipment, servers, handsets, applications, and data processing). Scoring criteria: 1) Ban on more than one ICT goods or digital services 2) Ban on one specific product or services 3) No measure
